name: codex-beacon
description: Codex Beacon is an original floating desktop HUD for Codex: a geometric signal core that shows live turn state, context pressure, generation speed, subscription windows, and tool activity.

interface.shortDescription: A geometric live-status beacon for Codex sessions
interface.longDescription: Codex Beacon is a Windows desktop companion for Codex. It renders an original geometric signal core in a transparent always-on-top window and reads local Codex session telemetry to show the current turn state, context usage, throughput, first-token latency, 5-hour and weekly limits, and tool activity. It does not copy prompts, commands, or credentials into its state files.
defaultPrompt: 启动 Codex Beacon 桌宠
